capability.title: Full-Bleed Image Hero
capability.description: Full-viewport brand hero: natural-light food photograph behind a warm cream content panel that owns the page h1, an eyebrow, a supporting paragraph, two actions and a short trust-badge row.
useWhen: A home or landing page needs its h1 plus the primary ordering action above the fold
avoidWhen: A page needs a compact text-only intro, or a hero whose headline should sit over a dark scrim
